error_cases.zh: 秋天的傍晚，明亮的月光轻轻地洒在安静的湖面上。微风慢慢地吹过，金黄的叶子轻轻地落在清澈的水里。孩子们快乐地跑过石桥，大声地笑着。
error_cases.en: The clever young fox quietly crossed the dark river. It slowly climbed the steep bank and carefully watched the sleeping village. Suddenly a loud dog barked, and the frightened animal quickly ran into the dense forest.
error_cases.mixed:
她 quietly opened the 旧书，and carefully read every 句子。The tired 孩子们已经慢慢地睡着了，so I gently closed the window.

Tomorrow morning we will walk along the 安静的河边，and I will patiently tell them a new story.

zh_extra: 因为他生病了，所以今天没有来上课。
虽然天气很冷，但是他们仍然坚持训练。
如果明天下雨，我们就改在室内开会。
她不仅会说英语，而且还会写诗。
无论遇到什么困难，我们都不要放弃。
孩子们在花园里唱歌跳舞。
en_compare: The clever young fox quietly crossed the dark river.
It slowly climbed the steep bank and carefully watched the sleeping village.
Suddenly a loud dog barked, and the frightened animal quickly ran into the dense forest.
She wants to finish the report before Friday.
Running every morning keeps him healthy.
The broken window was repaired yesterday.
I saw him crossing the street.
They decided to leave after the meeting ended.
The book that she bought is interesting.
He is a man who always tells the truth.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
Although she was tired, she finished the work.
Tom and Mary opened the door and walked inside.
The sleeping child did not hear the noise.
Tomorrow morning we will walk along the river.
I was tired and frightened after the storm.
She asked me to open the old book carefully.
Because he was late, the teacher was angry.
The students who studied hard passed the exam.
Having finished dinner, they left the restaurant.
